pageDesc: Explore, customize, and evaluate ATS-oriented English resume templates with live A4 preview, plain text reading, and local structure checks.
atsDisclaimer: These templates prioritize clear structure and readable text. Parsing behavior may vary between applicant tracking systems.

atsStructureCheckDesc: Evaluates document layout against standard applicant tracking system extraction principles.

singleColumn.title: Single-Column Architecture
singleColumn.desc: Uses a continuous top-to-bottom single column flow for reliable reading order.

textBased.title: Selectable Text Content
textBased.desc: All text rendered as selectable DOM text without canvas or image conversion.

noTables.title: No Layout Tables
noTables.desc: Layout structured without HTML <table> elements to prevent multi-cell text mixing.

noSkillBars.title: No Decorative Skill Bars
noSkillBars.desc: Skills listed as readable text tags without arbitrary percentage graphics.

noPhoto.title: No Profile Photo
noPhoto.desc: Omits headshot images in compliance with standard US/UK ATS guidelines.

contactInBody.title: Contact Details in Main Flow
contactInBody.desc: Email, phone, and location placed in primary body header rather than margin headers.

standardHeadings.title: Standard Section Labels
standardHeadings.desc: Uses recognized English section headers (Experience, Education, Skills, Summary).

safeFont.title: Standard Web Typography
safeFont.desc: Applies clean, universally supported sans-serif fonts.

fontSize.title: Readable Text Size
fontSize.desc: Text sized safely (10pt–12pt equivalent) to prevent extraction clipping.

readingOrder.title: Logical DOM Sequence
readingOrder.desc: Visual section placement matches DOM reading order exactly.

validOrder.title: Complete Section Hierarchy
validOrder.desc: Core sections arranged in logical reverse-chronological sequence.

safeLinks.title: Safe Hyperlink URLs
safeLinks.desc: Links formatted with valid http, mailto, or tel protocols.

technicalPrimeATS.name: Technical Prime ATS
technicalPrimeATS.description: Flagship ATS-optimized single-column layout with grouped technical skills, ideal for engineering and tech roles.

classicATS.name: Classic ATS
classicATS.description: Ultra-clean single-column vertical layout ensuring maximum parsing clarity across standard recruitment platforms.

professionalATS.name: Professional ATS
professionalATS.description: Refined executive presentation with subtle accent dividers, ideal for corporate and management roles.

compactATS.name: Compact ATS
compactATS.description: Single-column layout with tight spacing and concise typography intended for single-page CVs.

executiveATS.name: Executive ATS
executiveATS.description: Bold header styling with dedicated executive summary box and achievement-oriented experience layout.

developer.name: Developer Portfolio
developer.description: Specialized technical layout highlighting technology stacks, GitHub repositories, and software projects.
